items.title: investingLive Asia-Pacific market news: Yen surges to six-month high
items.summary: RBA's Hunter flags deliberate cooling in housing and broader growth China exports match forecast in August, imports fall short as domestic demand stays soft Kospi surges past 7,130 on chips, Nikkei ekes out modest gain China August trade balance shows imports below expectations China's Rio Tinto ore purchasing halt appears set to take effect. AUD down.
items.summaryZh: RBA的Hunter标志着房地产市场故意降温， 8月份中国出口增长与预测相符，由于国内需求保持疲软，进口不足， Kospi在芯片上飙升超过7,130 ，日经指数小幅上涨中国8月份贸易平衡显示进口低于预期中国力拓矿石采购暂停似乎将生效。澳元下跌。

AUD down.

items.summary: Crude oil technicals: Buyers test key resistance near $93.50 European major indices close mixed on the day Copper reaches a new record high on the LME Kickstart the North American FX session. The USDJPY is the big mover.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 原油技术指标：买家在LME启动北美外汇交易日的铜价创下历史新高之日，测试接近93.50 $的欧洲主要指数收盘价的主要阻力位。USDJPY是最大的推动者。
items.summaryEn: Crude oil technicals: Buyers test key resistance near $93.50 European major indices close mixed on the day Copper reaches a new record high on the LME Kickstart the North American FX session. The USDJPY is the big mover.
